entities.summary: Ken K. Mary is an American musician who has worked as a drummer, producer, engineer, and record executive on over thirty-five albums. He has worked in genres from heavy rock to choral music. Mary is best known for his work with acts such as TKO, Chastain, Fifth Angel, Bonfire, Alice Cooper, House of Lords, Accept and Impellitteri, and is currently the drummer of Flotsam and Jetsam, Jack Russell's Great White/Once Bitten, and Metal Church.
